# Pull Request Checklist

This repository is maintained as a public specification. Pull requests are accepted only when explicitly requested by FoundLab.

## Change Type

- [ ] Documentation correction
- [ ] Specification clarification
- [ ] Claims-hygiene patch
- [ ] Broken-link fix
- [ ] Typo / formatting
- [ ] Other

## Required Checks

- [ ] Does not introduce customer-specific or NDA material
- [ ] Does not introduce unconditional legal-compliance claims
- [ ] Does not claim crypto-shredding is instantaneous deletion
- [ ] Does not claim BigQuery alone is terminal WORM storage
- [ ] Does not introduce unverifiable latency, production, or security claims
- [ ] Updates related files if a normative definition changed
- [ ] Links are valid

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is required.
